{Elemental Ritual — Fire}

The Conflux recognizes a complete Fire set in your army.

If you accept, this town will spend its only Elemental Ritual. The ritual will sacrifice: 2 Firebirds, 2 Phoenixes, 4 Efreets, 4 Efreet Sultans, 10 Fire Elementals and 10 Energy Elementals.

Magic Elementals remain as the living catalyst.

Ritual reward:
